paragraphs: Vardimos, son of Rabbi Yose, is Rabbi Menachem, son of Rabbi Yose (see his entry), whose face resembled a beautiful rose: chapter Kol Kitvei. In Sifra, Emor: Avardimos. At the beginning of Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot, and Bereshit Rabbah, Vayeshev,chapter 85: Avdimos, a scribal error.
